target_customer: Business brokers, plus buyers and sellers of small businesses
problem: Buying and selling a small business is slow and paperwork heavy, with NDAs, valuations and listings handled in generic tools.
business_model: SaaS subscription for business brokers (CRM, data rooms, valuations); originally a listing marketplace
product_category: Small business M&A software and marketplace

founders.name: George Wellmer
previous_startups: A valuation business for SBA 7(a) loans
founders.background_notes: IBBA broker profile: worked in banking and with the SBA before Tupelo; employers not named.

founders.name: Zac Wellmer
founders.background_notes: Listed by the YC page with no background.

competitors.name: BizBuySell
competitors.what: Largest online marketplace for businesses for sale, with broker listings
competitors.traction_then: Reported small business sales in 2020 fell 22 percent from 2019 with a median price of 279,950 dollars
competitors.funding_then: owned by a larger company, not stated in the source

technical_complexity.rationale: Listing, NDA and CRM workflow software with accounting integrations; standard SaaS for a team of two.

defensibility.rationale: Broker workflow data can create stickiness, but the marketplace side faces entrenched listing sites and the software is easy to copy.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source shows an incumbent copying or buying Tupelo; it kept operating and publishing a broker newsletter through 2025.

market_need_then: Small business sales were a large fragmented market run by brokers using generic CRMs; a testimonial on the site contrasts Tupelo with generic CRMs.

branding.domain_note: Uses tupelosmb.com, so the plain tupelo.com was not used.

identity.voice_and_tone: Plain and friendly; site tagline calls it powerfully simple CRM

branding.community_and_virality: Publishes the Acquisition Odyssey newsletter for deal makers; no merch or fan evidence.

brand_strength.rationale: Search results for the name are dominated by Tupelo, Mississippi and tupelo honey; the only brand asset found is a newsletter.

pivots.from: Small business M&A marketplace with integrations
pivots.to: CRM and deal tools for business brokers
pivots.why: Not stated by a source; the YC page says marketplace while the company site and broker profiles describe broker software

outcome_analysis: Tupelo is a two person YC W21 company that still operates in 2025, now positioned as software for business brokers rather than a buyer and seller marketplace. No funding beyond YC could be verified and there is no evidence of rapid growth or failure, so the story is a small, quietly surviving company that moved to the broker workflow niche. The reason for the shift is not public.
notes: One tracker lists a 125k pre-seed dated March 2021 from Y Combinator; aggregator only, and YC standard deal is not a round. BizBuySell source date is the 2020 annual report, month not stated in the snippet. Other competitors such as Axial were seen only in undated pages and are not listed.
